references.text: God commands Moses to carve two new stone tablets like the first ones he broke
Moses wrote the Ten Commandments on the tablets, the words of the covenant
Moses broke the first tablets when he saw the golden calf and the people dancing
The testimony (the tablets) was to be placed in the ark
The mercy seat was to be placed over the ark with the testimony inside
Moses put the testimony in the ark as God had commanded
Parallel text describing that God wrote the Ten Commandments on the tablets and Moses placed them in the ark
There was nothing in the ark except the two stone tablets that Moses placed there at Horeb
The ark of the covenant contained, among other things, the stone tablets with the covenant
